suggested_solution: Run a stress test (e.g., Unigine Heaven, Valley) to identify potential thermal or driver-related issues.
Check for BIOS updates and install the latest version.
Verify that all drivers are up-to-date, including NVIDIA GeForce and Intel Core i9-12900H drivers.
Monitor system temperatures and adjust cooling settings as needed.
Consider running a memory stress test to identify potential RAM-related issues.
